question: During the peak of the revolutionary phase of the Indian freedom struggle, an assassination attempt on a district magistrate of Muzaffarpur led to the uncovering of the Alipore Conspiracy in 1908. What was the name of the magistrate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Douglas Kingsford **__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Alipore Bombay Case Trial refers to an attempt to murder the district judge of Muzaffarpur.
 
• Aurobindo Ghosh was defended by Chittaranjas Das in the Alipore bomb case.
 
• The Alipore Bomb case conspiracy took place in the year 1908.
 
• It is also known as the Manicktolla bomb conspiracy or Muraripukar conspiracy.
 
• Douglas Kingsford the unpopular British Chief Magistrate was the target of the bomb thrown at Muzaffarpur (Northern Bihar).
